projects.name: Supplier inventory lifecycle
projects.outcome: Suppliers can safely intake, select, publish, synchronize, and withdraw inventory without corrupting listing or transaction state.

projects.name: Recycling transaction lifecycle and conversations
projects.outcome: A battery supply group becomes a trustworthy commercial lot and a safe, measurable conversation from public listing to supplier response.

projects.name: Public marketplace acquisition and discovery
projects.outcome: Public visitors can find governed catalogue and recycler routes and recover when a listing URL is stale or missing.

projects.name: EV repair-partner network
projects.outcome: A verified repair-shop evidence set becomes a useful public directory and, only when supported, a relationship channel.

projects.name: Governed network discovery
projects.outcome: Produce human-reviewed, evidence-backed buyer candidates without accidental publishing, contacting, or spend.

projects.name: Canonical battery intelligence and trust
projects.outcome: Battery identity, ontology, evidence, imagery, review, and promotion have a traceable source of truth.

projects.name: Website measurement and decision intelligence
projects.outcome: Privacy-safe, attributable product events become reliable recurring evidence for product decisions.

projects.name: Meeting evidence and learning system
projects.outcome: Meetings become a complete, retrievable, reviewable evidence corpus with safe, controlled handoff into knowledge and work.

projects.name: Alex email triage and relationship drafting
projects.outcome: One deterministic, auditable Gmail triage and draft flow handles mailbox state safely without competing writers.

projects.name: Execution observability
projects.outcome: Important AI executions have attributable traces of action, cost, completion, and failure.

projects.name: Work-task evidence pipeline
projects.outcome: Work-task execution evidence is normalized and projected into a reliable task history.

projects.name: Trace platform operations
projects.outcome: The trace platform remains available, reconciled, and operationally owned.

projects.name: Safe change delivery and production feedback
projects.outcome: Code changes are verified, production failures are actionable, side effects cannot leak from tests, and developer environments are portable.
